# Citadel — Minefort Citadel developer documentation

> Minefort's Luau scripting engine for Minecraft servers, restructured
> as a developer wiki: core concepts, task-focused guides, cookbook
> recipes and appendices (61 pages), plus the complete API
> reference — 170 globals and types, 674 documented
> members, each with signature, parameters, returns and usage. Routes
> are site-relative: prefix them with the deployment origin. Every API
> member also has its own page at `/ref/<Parent>/<member>/`.
>
> The same content in one file: [llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt).

## API reference

- [API reference](/ref/): Every Citadel global, type and member — 29 globals in five domains, 141 types, 674 documented members, each with…

### World & game

- [world global · type World](/ref/World/): A room's blocks, entities, displays, screens and time: the world global, or room.world.
- [game global · type Game](/ref/Game/): The game version a room runs, its entity kinds, blocks and items, and the pack's own blocks, items…
- [models global](/ref/models/): The models this pack makes, for world.display{ kind = "model" }.
- [parts global](/ref/parts/): Named parts of a stored world and the generators that build them.
- [routes global](/ref/routes/): How players get between the worlds of the group.
- [noise global](/ref/noise/): Smooth random numbers for a generator, made by the engine.
- [fields global](/ref/fields/): Recipes for numbers over the world, for world.generate.
- [data global](/ref/data/): Helpers for persistent data views — data.copy, data.insert, data.remove.

### Players

- [players global · type Players](/ref/Players/): A room's players and their events: the players global, or room.players.
- [camera global](/ref/camera/): Camera paths and modes per player.

### Interface & media

- [ui global · type Ui](/ref/Ui/): Titles, chat, the action bar, boss bars, the sidebar and the tab list: for everyone in a room (the…
- [fx global · type Fx](/ref/Fx/): Particles for a room: Minecraft's particle packet; the fx global, or room.fx.
- [sound global · type Sound](/ref/Sound/): Plays and stops sounds for everyone in a room: the sound global, or room.sound.
- [message global](/ref/message/): A chat line to everyone in the main room.
- [tween global](/ref/tween/): Any live field eased over time — numbers, vec3 and color values.
- [color global](/ref/color/): Colour helpers: hsv, gradients and nearest-map-colour.
- [colors global](/ref/colors/): The named colour table: Minecraft's sixteen and more.

### Systems

- [commands global · type Commands](/ref/Commands/): Adds a room's slash commands from a usage line: the commands global, or room.commands.
- [time global](/ref/time/): Clocks for a pack: a callback every tick, one every few seconds, and the seconds since the pack…
- [task global](/ref/task/): The scheduler: spawn, delay, defer, wait and cancel.
- [rooms global](/ref/rooms/): Making and destroying rooms — isolated worlds with their own tables.
- [storage global](/ref/storage/): A per-pack JSON file that survives a restart.
- [stores global](/ref/stores/): The experience's shared store: versioned facts, blobs and leases across every server.
- [http global](/ref/http/): HTTP requests from the pack, with caching.
- [network global](/ref/network/): WebSockets out and listening sockets, for multiplayer-scale IO.
- [shop global](/ref/shop/): Minefort's Gem shop: prompts, ownership and paid delivery.
- [hub global](/ref/hub/): The Minefort hub: servers, experiences and portals.

### Engine

- [citadel global](/ref/citadel/): The engine itself: the log, versions, environment and the tick budget.
- [vec3 global](/ref/vec3/): Positions and directions with x, y, z — plus lerp, distance and friends.

### Types A–Z

- [AskCount type](/ref/AskCount/): What one kind of ask has cost this pack, and what every kind has together
- [Asks type](/ref/Asks/): What the engine's questions with a deadline have cost this pack, in total and per kind:…
- [Bar type](/ref/Bar/): A boss bar, from ui.bossbar for the room or player.ui.bossbar for one player; title, progress and…
- [BarColor type](/ref/BarColor/): A boss bar's colour is its own closed set — six the client draws, and anything else is white
- [Billboard type](/ref/Billboard/): How a display turns toward the viewer: "fixed" never turns, "vertical" turns about the up axis,…
- [BiomeDefinition type](/ref/BiomeDefinition/): What a pack changes about the vanilla biome its own biome copies
- [Biomes type](/ref/Biomes/): The biomes a pack adds to the game.
- [Block type](/ref/Block/): One block the game version has, in its own numbers, from game.block(name): hardness, light, fire…
- [BlockAmendSpec type](/ref/BlockAmendSpec/): What game.blocks.amend takes: hooks only
- [BlockAt type](/ref/BlockAt/): The block a hook was called about
- [BlockDef type](/ref/BlockDef/): The handle define hands back
- [BlockPick type](/ref/BlockPick/): One block, or one of a list chosen by a field: floor(by) counts through the list and starts again…
- [BlockRef type](/ref/BlockRef/): A block, as anything that takes one will take it.
- [Blocks type](/ref/Blocks/): game.blocks: defines a pack's own blocks and amends the game's own, at load time.
- [BlockSpec type](/ref/BlockSpec/): What a definition says a block is
- [Body type](/ref/Body/): Whatever is standing on one
- [BodyRotation type](/ref/BodyRotation/): Degrees: 0 yaw faces south, 90 west; positive pitch tips down
- [Breaker type](/ref/Breaker/): What took a block out, and with what.
- [Budget type](/ref/Budget/): What a pack's tick and event callbacks are allowed per tick, together, and what it did with it
- [Builder type](/ref/Builder/): What world.build hands the function it is given
- [Camera type](/ref/Camera/): Camera reference — every call, field and type in one place.
- [Canvas type](/ref/Canvas/): A picture of one or more maps with no frame of its own, from world.canvas, for a frame display, a…
- [ChaseCamera type](/ref/ChaseCamera/): ChaseCamera reference — every call, field and type in one place.
- [Chunk type](/ref/Chunk/): A 16 by 16 column of blocks, handed to world.on_generate, world.on_populate and a room's generate…
- [Color type](/ref/Color/): Color reference — every call, field and type in one place.
- [ColorName type](/ref/ColorName/): Every colour's name: Minecraft's sixteen, which every client has had since 1.7, six more, and…
- [Command type](/ref/Command/): A command a pack added, from commands.add; change its suggestions or cancel it.
- [CommandOpts type](/ref/CommandOpts/): The options of commands.add: a permission node, aliases, the /help line and suggestions per…
- [Connection type](/ref/Connection/): An event subscription or repeating timer; task functions return threads.
- [Container type](/ref/Container/): A chest's stacks: world.container(pos)
- [Context type](/ref/Context/): How an item display is posed; a read gives back the same words.
- [DamageHit type](/ref/DamageHit/): A hit on a player, before it lands: what players.on_damage hands a pack.
- [DataView type](/ref/DataView/): An attached JSON record/list, with tracked nested writes and generalized iteration
- [Dialog type](/ref/Dialog/): An open dialog, from player.ui.dialog.
- [DialogNode type](/ref/DialogNode/): A node of a dialog, made by ui.kit: a table with a kind.
- [Display type](/ref/Display/): An item, text, block or frame shown in the world, from world.display; its place, rotation, scale…
- [Drops type](/ref/Drops/): What a broken block leaves
- [DurableStore type](/ref/DurableStore/): Shared durable stores
- [Easing type](/ref/Easing/): How a tween moves over its duration: "linear" (the default) at one speed, "in" starts slow, "out"…
- [Effect type](/ref/Effect/): A function called for every letter each frame a text shows, handing back how that letter looks; i…
- [Entities type](/ref/Entities/): game.entities: the three verbs over one shape.
- [EntityAmendOptions type](/ref/EntityAmendOptions/): A pack's hooks on one of the game's own entities
- [EntityAmendSpec type](/ref/EntityAmendSpec/): Called when a new entity of this kind spawns; told, never waited on.
- [EntityCamera type](/ref/EntityCamera/): EntityCamera reference — every call, field and type in one place.
- [EntityDef type](/ref/EntityDef/): What define{} hands back
- [EntityHandle type](/ref/EntityHandle/): A body the world moves: a pack's own entity, a mob, a stack on the ground
- [EntityKind type](/ref/EntityKind/): One kind the game version has, in its own numbers, from game.entities.<kind>: name, size,…
- [EntitySpec type](/ref/EntitySpec/): A kind of entity a pack makes up
- [Face type](/ref/Face/): One of a block's six faces: up, down, north, south, west or east, as hit.face and world.raycast…
- [Faces type](/ref/Faces/): A block's faces: one picture, or all, side, top, bottom, front, back, or a face by name.
- [Facing type](/ref/Facing/): One of the four sides: north, south, west or east; a facing block's front, or the side a screen…
- [Feature type](/ref/Feature/): What a client is able to show
- [Field type](/ref/Field/): A number at every block, as a recipe the engine works out
- [FixedCamera type](/ref/FixedCamera/): Camera modes expose only the fields they use
- [FluidRule type](/ref/FluidRule/): The carved air under below becomes block (a lake, lava): the first rule that holds at each block
- [FreeCamera type](/ref/FreeCamera/): FreeCamera reference — every call, field and type in one place.
- [Generated type](/ref/Generated/): A declared world, for the script to ask what the engine answers.
- [GeneratorRules type](/ref/GeneratorRules/): What world.generate takes
- [GroundItem type](/ref/GroundItem/): One stack lying on the ground.
- [GroundRule type](/ref/GroundRule/): A layer of ground: block for the top depth blocks (1) of a surface
- [HeadSkin type](/ref/HeadSkin/): Whose face a player head shows: a Minecraft account's name, or the textures profile property of a…
- [Hit type](/ref/Hit/): What players.on_click hands its callback: the button, the slot, and the player, entity, block and…
- [Hitbox type](/ref/Hitbox/): An invisible box a player can click, and a wall when solid, from world.hitbox (1.19.4 and later).
- [HttpResponse type](/ref/HttpResponse/): What http.get returns
- [Hud type](/ref/Hud/): A layout on one player's screen, from player.ui.show
- [HudPart type](/ref/HudPart/): One item of a shown layout, hud.hp: its live values
- [Ink type](/ref/Ink/): Anywhere a colour is asked for, every spelling works: a color value, a name, or hex ("#ff8800")
- [InventorySlot type](/ref/InventorySlot/): A stack as a script reads it
- [Item type](/ref/Item/): An item the game version has, from game.item(name): its name and stack size.
- [ItemMatch type](/ref/ItemMatch/): An item to find — take, count, a recipe's ingredient
- [ItemMeta type](/ref/ItemMeta/): The extras an item table may carry: count, name, lore, colours, glint, a canvas map, a pack item…
- [Items type](/ref/Items/): game.items: items of the pack's own.
- [ItemSpec type](/ref/ItemSpec/): An item is a name, or a table with the meta it carries.
- [ItemTable type](/ref/ItemTable/): An item table names an item, or a canvas whose map it is.
- [Layout type](/ref/Layout/): A layout the resource pack holds: what ui.define hands back.
- [LayoutAlign type](/ref/LayoutAlign/): How a row, a column or a stack lines its children up, and a label its words.
- [LayoutNode type](/ref/LayoutNode/): A piece of a layout's tree: what ui.box, ui.image, ui.label, ui.row, ui.column and ui.stack hand…
- [LetterStyle type](/ref/LetterStyle/): What an effect hands back for one letter; text shows something else in its place ("" hides it).
- [LightSource type](/ref/LightSource/): One spot of light no block makes, for world.light: a position and a level from 1 to 15.
- [Looks type](/ref/Looks/): What a client is told a pack's entity is: a shape it already draws
- [Material type](/ref/Material/): A block's material as five yes-or-no questions, from block.material: solid, covers, firm, liquid…
- [Menu type](/ref/Menu/): An open menu, from player.ui.menu.
- [Model type](/ref/Model/): A model the pack made, for world.display{ kind = "model" }.
- [ModelBuild type](/ref/ModelBuild/): What models.new hands its build function: makes the model's materials, textures, parts and…
- [ModelDisplay type](/ref/ModelDisplay/): A model visual in a room
- [ModelMaterial type](/ref/ModelMaterial/): A flat colour in a model
- [ModelPart type](/ref/ModelPart/): A named group of boxes that turns around its pivot
- [ModelSkin type](/ref/ModelSkin/): What a box wears: one for all six faces, or one per face.
- [ModelTexture type](/ref/ModelTexture/): Pixel art for one face of a box: plain RGBA, and never repainted.
- [MountTarget type](/ref/MountTarget/): Handles accepted by mounting and cameras; a Model is an asset, not a target.
- [NetworkInstance type](/ref/NetworkInstance/): An instance of a member: a server the network started for itself.
- [NetworkStarted type](/ref/NetworkStarted/): What network.start and network.find answer.
- [Noise type](/ref/Noise/): Smooth random numbers from noise.new: the same seed gives the same numbers every time.
- [Npc type](/ref/Npc/): A player-shaped entity every client from 1.8 sees, from world.npc; it can walk, talk, hold items,…
- [NpcPose type](/ref/NpcPose/): How an NPC holds its body: standing, crouching, sleeping or swimming.
- [Occupant type](/ref/Occupant/): Occupant reference — every call, field and type in one place.
- [OrbitCamera type](/ref/OrbitCamera/): OrbitCamera reference — every call, field and type in one place.
- [Orientation type](/ref/Orientation/): Displays also accept a nose direction and roof direction; reads return angles.
- [Overlay type](/ref/Overlay/): A canvas on one player's screen, from player.ui.overlay: 128 by 128, drawn like a canvas
- [PartDefinition type](/ref/PartDefinition/): A named part of a stored world (world: <folder>) and the generator that writes it
- [Persist type](/ref/Persist/): Whether a kind survives a save
- [Physics type](/ref/Physics/): Which order of operations moves a body
- [Picture type](/ref/Picture/): The calls a screen, a canvas and a view all share.
- [PlantRule type](/ref/PlantRule/): A plant on a column
- [Player type](/ref/Player/): A player in the room: what players.on_join and every player event hand you.
- [PlayerUi type](/ref/PlayerUi/): player.ui: the calls ui has, for one player alone, plus what only one player's screen holds.
- [Puppet type](/ref/Puppet/): A mob's body with no mind of its own that the script moves, from world.puppet; its name tag always…
- [RayHit type](/ref/RayHit/): The first block a ray met, and the face it came in through.
- [Recipes type](/ref/Recipes/): game.recipes: what a crafting grid and a furnace make of a pack's items
- [Room type](/ref/Room/): An isolated world with its own players and tables, from rooms.create or rooms.main.
- [Rotation type](/ref/Rotation/): Rotation reference — every call, field and type in one place.
- [Rules type](/ref/Rules/): Which parts of the player simulation this room runs

- [Screen type](/ref/Screen/): A wall or floor of map frames showing a picture, from world.screen; it draws like a canvas and can…
- [ScreenFacing type](/ref/ScreenFacing/): The side a frame display hangs on: a wall side, or "up" to lie flat on a floor or table (1.13 and…
- [ShopPurchase type](/ref/ShopPurchase/): A purchase the player paid for, in Gems, that the pack has not handed over.
- [Slow type](/ref/Slow/): One overrun, as citadel.on_slow is handed it.
- [Socket type](/ref/Socket/): A WebSocket a pack opened with http.socket.
- [SocketMessage type](/ref/SocketMessage/): One message of a socket.
- [SoundSpeaker type](/ref/SoundSpeaker/): Where a speaker is: a point, or a player or an entity it follows.
- [SoundStream type](/ref/SoundStream/): A sound sound.stream plays
- [Suggester type](/ref/Suggester/): Called as the player types; must answer at once (no task.wait)
- [Suggestion type](/ref/Suggestion/): One word offered as a player types a command argument: a string, or a text with a tooltip.
- [TerrainStep type](/ref/TerrainStep/): One populate step of the overworld, as citadel.yml writes it, read from game.terrain.steps.
- [Text type](/ref/Text/): A string, a table of runs, or a function of the time (time.now()) handing back a text, worked out…
- [TextRuns type](/ref/TextRuns/): Words wherever the API shows them: a string, or a table of runs
- [Texture type](/ref/Texture/): A picture drawn in code: game.texture(w, h)
- [TextureRef type](/ref/TextureRef/): A block or item picture: a Texture drawn in code with game.texture, or the name of a PNG file in…
- [ThingGrid type](/ref/ThingGrid/): Things that share one grid of cell blocks (8): a cell holds at most one, at a place that is the…
- [ThingRule type](/ref/ThingRule/): A thing that stands on a grid cell: one of shapes, its (0, 0, 0) on the block above the ground
- [Think type](/ref/Think/): What on_think gets: n bodies, and one buffer for each column with one f64 per body (entry i at byte…
- [TimeName type](/ref/TimeName/): A named time of day that world.time holds the sky at: sunrise, day, noon, sunset, night or midnight.
- [Trigger type](/ref/Trigger/): Something that happened to a block.
- [Tween type](/ref/Tween/): A field easing over time, from tween or camera.path.
- [Used type](/ref/Used/): What on_use answers
- [Vec3 type](/ref/Vec3/): Vec3 reference — every call, field and type in one place.
- [Video type](/ref/Video/): A raw RGB video playing on a picture, from picture:play; read playing or call stop.
- [View type](/ref/View/): One player's own layer over a screen or canvas, from screen:view(player); only they see it, drawn…
- [WorldTarget type](/ref/WorldTarget/): WorldTarget reference — every call, field and type in one place.
- [Worn type](/ref/Worn/): Armour, head first; each piece is an item like any other.
- [Zone type](/ref/Zone/): A box of blocks that knows who is in it, checked once a tick.
